title: Shifting Corpus Ring
summary: Casts level 2 Invisibility and Blur once each per Long Rest.

fields.Invisibility: Action, touch, Concentration up to 10 turns. Target attacks with advantage and attackers have disadvantage. Attacking, casting, many actions or taking damage ends it early.
fields.Blur: Self Action, Concentration up to 10 turns. Attackers have disadvantage unless they do not rely on sight or can see through illusions.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
